app.name: Invitation System
app.tagline: Digital event invitations, one link per event

errors.failed: Sign in failed. Try again in a moment

noAccess.title: No access

eventForm.isActive: Event is active (guests can open the invitation page)

geo.found: Found: {label}. Check that this is the right place.
geo.notFound: No location found for this address. Try writing it differently or enter coordinates by hand.

video.title: Our video

findTable.rateLimited: Too many searches. Try again in a few minutes.

registration.phoneHint: To update your RSVP later, register again with the same number

registration.thanksCreated: {count, plural, one {You are registered. See you there!} other {You are registered, # guests. See you there!}}

errors.closed: Registration for this event is closed.

registrations.loadFailed: Could not load registrations. Refresh the page.
registrations.empty: No registrations yet. Share the invitation link or add one by hand.
registrations.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone, email or note
